assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production fantasy strategy-game UI nine-slice square frame, 1024x1024. Front-facing orthographic. A narrow richly hand-painted frame made from polished midnight-indigo stone with aged brass edging, delicate engraved celestial runes (abstract marks, not readable text), small amethyst crystal inlays and fine astronomical filigree. The material should feel tactile and sculpted, sophisticated wizard's observatory furniture, restrained light from violet crystals, neutral highlights. Four straight continuous rails occupy only the outer 10 percent, slightly more elaborate angular brass corner joints occupy the outer 18 percent. Middle stretches simple and repeatable for responsive nine-slice rendering. Completely transparent empty central rectangle occupying at least 64 percent in both dimensions; transparent outside the frame with 2 percent margin. Frame square to image, no perspective, no scenery, no people, no interface controls, no letters or numerals, no logos. Actual alpha transparency, not a checkerboard. All decorative pieces inside image, nothing cropped. This must be a usable border asset, not a UI mockup.
